description: Local code-intelligence MCP server: hybrid code search, static call graph and project memory for AI coding agents.
rules: Before you install, measure it on the project: uvx --python 3.12 nexus-mcp-ci eval (free, offline, no LLM calls).
Register with Claude Code: claude mcp add nexus-mcp -- nexus-mcp-ci
No setup call is needed: the stored index attaches when the server starts. Call index only if a tool answers 'No codebase indexed'.
Call edges are static and name-based: treat graph results as a lower bound.
The index in .nexus/ holds code snippets: add .nexus/ to .gitignore.
